description: Title on container: The Middle East, beyond the headlines lies understanding

Explores causes and effects of different types of revolution that have plagued the Middle East, especially since World War II, and discusses the impact of revolution on the region as a whole. The film's guest experts show that, in Iraq's case, revolutionary activity sought to change the past. By contrast, the Iranian revolution aimed to recreate the past
